nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared configuration constants (debounce, batch, flush, and timeout intervals) and enum-like maps for activity, search-scope, and error types used by the Flow Awareness activity tracking system.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript type and interface definitions for the Flow Awareness system, covering activity inputs, flow summaries, and the useFlowAwareness hook's option/return contracts.
nodes.languageNotes: Type definitions are designed to mirror corresponding Rust backend structs so the Tauri IPC boundary stays consistent between frontend and backend.

nodes.name: useFlowAwareness.ts
nodes.summary: React hook that batches, deduplicates, debounces, and flushes user activity events (file edits, terminal commands, searches, git ops, errors) to the Rust backend over Tauri RPC, and exposes getContext/getSummary/clearSession query methods.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses refs plus useCallback extensively to implement an in-memory debounced batching queue without triggering re-renders on every recorded activity.

nodes.name: useGlobalFlowTracker.ts
nodes.summary: React hook mounted at the app root that subscribes to Tauri file:changed, repo:changed, and lint:tool_completed events and forwards them into the Flow Awareness activity tracker via useFlowAwareness.

nodes.name: useFlowAwareness
nodes.summary: Implements activity batching/debouncing/flushing logic with refs and useCallback, and returns recordActivity/recordFileEdit/recordTerminalCommand/etc. convenience functions plus getContext, getSummary, and clearSession RPC query methods.

nodes.name: useGlobalFlowTracker
nodes.summary: Subscribes to Tauri events (file:changed, repo:changed, lint:tool_completed) on mount and records corresponding file edit, git operation, and lint error activities via useFlowAwareness, cleaning up listeners on unmount.
